title: What WASSCE and WAEC results mean for Turkish admission
excerpt: How West African secondary results are read by Turkish universities, why subject grades matter more than the aggregate, and what that means for competitive programmes.

children.text: Turkish universities read a West African secondary certificate through denklik, and then assess it against the requirements of the specific programme applied for.

The most common misunderstanding is that the aggregate is what counts. For competitive programmes, particularly in health sciences, individual subject grades in biology, chemistry and mathematics carry more weight than the overall result.
